notes.title: New Menus, Better Graphics, Bug Fixes, Ranks and more, Beta 1.5 has arrived!
notes.notes:
[u][b]​Changes[/b][/u]
​
- All New Main Menu
- All New Customization Menu
- 2 new songs added (more to be added soon)
- Main menu music now plays continuously on shuffle
- Player Level/progression system added
- Progression menu added
- 98 tier “base” progression added with more items to be added in the near future
- Added basic division system, earn the most xp by winning matches, kills will earn bonus xp. Losing a match will cost you xp (though less than the xp gained from winning), D5 - PRO. This system will need fine tuning and adjustments, it’s important to release it in this state so we can gather feedback and build the best system possible. Once we have a solid system in place we’ll implement world leaderboards for stats and ranks.
- Hit registration has been further majorly reworked to feel more accurate and responsive across the - board
- Mid Atlantic 2024 Pro and non Pro layouts added
- Global text chat and team text chat added
- Team voice chat has been added. Only your team can hear you, when you die you'll be put into a general deadbox chat (anyone dead can hear each other)
- Field environment has been fully revamped
- Lighting and overall graphics quality have been improved
- Revised pause menu
- Revised server browser
- Revised server creation UI with Images of layouts
- Players nameplate above head now also shows their division
- Player names now become visible from any position when spectating
- Textures updated for I5, AMP, DSR, DLS, TM40 and R2
- Added many new skins to unlock
- Added kill streak ui animation
- Down time in between points has been decreased
- Main menu Gpu performance increased (In the unlikely event that your FPS is low on the Main Menu, try lowering the post processing setting)
- Player HUD reworked
  - Paint bar removed, your loader will now beep when the paint level is low
  - Stamina bar relocated and only shows on screen when it’s being drained
  - Snap direction arrow, stance indicator and pod count relocated to the bottom right
  - Added a fogged lens effect that fades in and out based on how low the stamina bar is
  - Scoreboard has been redesigned
- New UI animations to reflect gameplay milestones
  - Point Red/Blue
  - Victory/defeat
- Added post match results showing kills, deaths, best kill streak, progression xp earned and division xp earned or lost


[u][b]WIP / Changes Pending Further Testing[/b][/u]
- Fixed server player count in the server browser
- Fixed issue when closing pause menu with Escape key
- Gamepad support for UI is being worked on, Main Menu and Customization menus are currently supported with more being worked on

notes.title: Beta 1.5 Status Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Ethan here providing a quick update on where we’re at with Beta 1.5 and the status of the new voice chat component. 

First and foremost, voice chat was meant to be implemented shortly after the release of 1.4 and players have yet to see it in game. There have been some complications and I’m working hard to have it ready as soon as possible. I may go into further detail in a future update video and show the progress made so far. I apologize it’s taken longer than expected to rectify the bugs we’re experiencing I know a lot of you are really looking forward to talking in game.

On to Beta 1.5. Upon your first startup of the new update you will be greeted with an all new menu system, boasting new elements and features. The customization menu is also new from the ground up, each item labeled and pictured clearly, navigation is smooth, buttons are animated and the player model has 3 different camera angles so you can check out your newly earned gear up close….yes you heard that right, earned. 

A progression system has been implemented with stats being tracked and a post match report showing your performance/progress after each game completed. 

Some visual elements of the game have also been updated. Owen has tweaked/reworked some of the textures for some gear items. More color ways have been added and we have some new gear in the works. Additionally we’ve been experimenting with different lighting to improve visibility and graphical fidelity when you’re on the field.

That covers the primary changes made so far in 1.5, we are continuing make additions and refinements to this update so it’s an overall great experience for everyone upon release. I don’t have a solid ETA just yet. We’re working hard to get 1.5 wrapped up and out the door to the public, stay tuned for further updates and info. 

Thank you all for following our ongoing journey, there’s much more to come of Infinite!

notes.title: Beta 1.4 Release!
notes.notes:
[b][u]Beta 1.4 Update[/u][/b]
Staying true to the sport is extremely important to us, and Beta 1.4 brings Infinite even closer to our goal of creating the best tournament paintball simulation available. The base gameplay format has been updated to a true X-Ball format along with many other changes and fixes! 

As always, we encourage everyone to leave their feedback and bug reports in the official ITP discord linked below.

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u] 

- Base game mode is now a true X-Ball format
- Server host can now adjust game mode preferences such as
 - Time limit
 - Score limit
 - Win condition (Mercy or Race to point limit)
- Fixed rounds not ending when last 2 players trade out
- Rounds will now end within 10 seconds if enemy team is eliminated and the buzzer is not pressed
- Fixed team colors sometimes showing incorrectly 
- Player HUD has been updated/new elements added
 - Team score, time, and point number displayed at top of screen
 - Stamina bar updated
 - Added snap direction and stance indicator in bottom left
 - Paint bar updated
 - Pod counter updated
- Paint splatter updated to yellow with new textures
 - 4 variants of paint splatter added
- Marker sway system reworked
 - Marker sway now works on lower FPS settings
 - Sway is no longer choppy on lower end systems
 - Marker barrel now leads in the direction you aim instead of lagging behind
- The physical scoreboard model you see on the field is now fully functional 
- Paint will now bounce when it hits the net or ground (client side only, also no bounce shots yet)
- Marker textures updated
- New tank model and textures
- Players gear now replicates correctly 
- Marker down mechanic added to the beginning of each point. Your marker will automatically raise and lower at the sound of the buzzer, there is a .5 second fire delay after the buzzer sounds
- MVPS Winter Classic 2024 layout added

[u][b]Coming Soon[/b][/u]

- Dedicated Servers
- Voice Chat

notes.title: Beta 1.3.4 Patch / New Setting Menu!
notes.notes:
Today's patch brings some much needed QOL additions/changes, including an all new setting menu with extra options for graphics, key bindings, gameplay and more! 

[u][i]Please report any new bugs/issues you may find in the #bug-report or #feedback channel in the ITP Discord and I'll get a patch out ASAP. [/i][/u]

Changes

- New Settings menu with extra options
- Keybinds save and load properly
- Gamepad keybinds can be changed
- Toggle to snap option added
- Sprinting changed to a single button press
- Sprinting is now limited to forward movement only 
- Hold to sprint option added
- Fixed ramping cycle not breaking immediately when a player is hit
- You can no longer shooting while diving

Thank you guys so much for playing, leaving feedback, sharing your ideas and reaching out in general. Seeing Infinite continue to grow and gain this much support has been the highlight of my year. The big picture goal has been to create a fun, realistic paintball game that can draw more attention to paintball as a whole. In 2024 we will continue to expand the game with new content, more game modes, a progression system, ranked mode and much more. Lets keep the train rolling as we close out the year!

- Ethan 
[i]Developer @ FiveTwo Games[/i]

notes.title: New Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone 

This message is mainly for our newer players. 

Last year (2021) I began rebuilding the game from the ground up. Almost all of the 3D assets will be/are new and much higher quality, the game mechanics are completely different, and there are new features everyone will love. I’ve been dedicating as much time as I can each week to building the game.

If you’d like to follow the progress closer and help test, consider becoming an insider and send me a direct message on Discord. https://discord.gg/ejdzHYB

Lastly, don’t forget to follow our Instagram @fivetwostudios.
